author: Varsaggo
quote:
As soon as Dan was let go I had held out hope that it wouldn't affect the new GTA in development. I hoped they had hired the right people to replace him, they didn't and it's not GTA. 
  When u have an IP as big as this the people running the show need to be aware that if the writers that made previous games what they are leave the company, u need to hire people just like them to replace them and maybe even have the ones leaving make sure they can pass the torch. The people in charge failed in so many ways when hiring the people to work and write this new game they failed horribly.. If I was a Share owner I would be furious with the people making decisions and probably have them fired by Monday before Thanksgiving... That is how bad they have **** up the franchise, this wasn't a different take, this was a fumble on the 1 yard line and returned for a touch down fail.... You can tell the people that had any technical abilities must have left the company also, can't even get into how bad so many things are in the game... People should be fired
